purpose: stress-test whether the frozen base-relative target-query and drug-query tail-regret objective can be optimized and can improve bidirectional ranking using only already available nonstructural development predictions

claim_boundary.this_is: an optimizer and objective pressure test on an intentionally permissive score-only adapter
this_is_not: authorization to train any Stage1 structural model
claim_boundary.success_interpretation: the dual-axis safe objective is computationally viable and merits retention for a future Stage1 experiment only if Stage0 independently passes all frozen gates
claim_boundary.failure_interpretation: the current dual-axis objective is weakened and must be revised or abandoned before any Stage1 use; Stage0 status cannot rescue a failed proxy objective

outer_protocol.for_each_held_fold: fit on the other two development folds and predict the held fold
outer_protocol.held_fold_usage: metrics only after its model has finished; never used for fitting, epoch selection, calibration, thresholding, or constraint updates

adapter.standardization: training-fold mean and standard deviation only

pair_and_risk_definition.pair_construction: all positive-negative Cartesian pairs within every evaluable query group inside the current training boundary; no random pair subsampling
pair_and_risk_definition.axis_aggregation: target and drug pairwise terms are each averaged within axis before applying their frozen coefficients

required_outputs: row-level out-of-fold probabilities for every learned variant and seed
per-fold and pooled micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC, and drug-macro AUPRC
per-fold and pooled target/drug group regret distributions and empirical CVaR_0.8
five-seed mean, standard deviation, and win counts
target-homology-cluster and drug-scaffold clustered paired bootstrap uncertainty
target-query and drug-query grouped bootstrap uncertainty
machine-readable gate decision and full provenance hashes

proxy_gates.dual_seed_consistency: DUAL_CVAR must exceed BASE micro AUPRC in at least 4 of 5 seeds
proxy_gates.micro_cold_axis_uncertainty: DUAL_CVAR minus BASE micro AUPRC 95% lower bound must exceed 0 under both target-homology-cluster and drug-scaffold resampling
proxy_gates.target_direction: target-macro point difference versus BASE must be nonnegative and grouped-bootstrap 95% lower bound must be at least -0.002
proxy_gates.drug_direction: drug-macro grouped-bootstrap 95% lower bound versus BASE must exceed 0
proxy_gates.tail_no_harm: pooled empirical target and drug CVaR_0.8 relative regret for DUAL_CVAR must each be <=0.01
proxy_gates.incremental_value: DUAL_CVAR must have nonnegative pooled target-macro and drug-macro differences versus ORDINARY_DUAL_QUERY
proxy_gates.permutation: DUAL_CVAR drug-macro AUPRC must exceed the 95th percentile of the frozen within-drug label-permutation null

hard_stops: abort if any fold outside 0-2 is observed
abort if any required identifier or score is missing
never modify or overwrite the frozen input
never use this proxy result to recover any of the 480 hard-gate or 24 later pocket-quality exclusions
never launch structural Stage1 from this script
